scope: Windows x64 JIT and actual package consumers. No Linux, Native AOT, original DSH source or cross-runtime differential, browser, named UI, hosted CI, Maker, source-archive build or remote SourceLink retrieval was executed for this checkpoint.

scopedContract.author: Assembly TypertContext declarations enter the common saved declaration model with structured wire types.
scopedContract.receiver: Context-bound invocation resolves the typed identity to the Host receiver; no public direct identity overload is emitted.
scopedContract.lookup: A direct method with exactly one matching lookup keeps its direct signature and gains a scoped signature omitting that lookup identity. The Host receiver stays direct.
scopedContract.lifetime: The retained view reads current identity and adapter on each call, observes adapter withdrawal and replacement, and cannot invoke through a disposed parent client. The HttpClient remains borrowed.
scopedContract.absence: Undefined.Value is refused before HTTP; explicit null is sent once and refused by the Host codec.
scopedContract.primaryOwner: The saved Remote package consumer in scripts/typert_declaration_consumer.py executes both scopes, direct lookup, downlink, identity changes, withdrawal/replacement, Host refusal and transport counts.
scopedContract.adaptation: An explicit ForContext view selects statically typed C# signatures; the parent client is the direct route. No JavaScript argument-count fallback or identity cache is added.
scopedContract.remaining: Browser scoped facade, owned values, Peer, uplink/bidirectional streams, complete events and attachments remain separate original obligations.

retainedNonAcceptanceRuns.reason: The first real call exposed explicit-null identity serialization as a local STJ failure. The request envelope was corrected without relaxing the Host codec or the assertion.
